notes.title: Update verion 1.05 - The real English version and a New Difficulty
notes.content:
Version 1.05 updates

[list]
[*] Thanks to the help of an enthusiastic player, there is now a comfortable English version of the game, and you will never be bothered by the language.
[*] A new game difficulty, the real owner of the abyss and its mutant monsters are waiting for your challenge in the abyss.
[*] Fix some bugs.
[/list]

As the game text has been modified, the names of some cards and monsters have changed, each player will get 1000 gems as compensation.

notes.title: Update verion 1.04 - The Gunner comes
notes.content:
Version 1.04 updates

[list]
[*] New hero Gunner.
[*] Now you can view past game histories at the start screen.
[*] Added shuffle function, which can be unlocked by completing tasks.
[*] Now the tasks will be displayed when entering the stage.
[*] Fix some bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update verion 1.03 - More random elements
notes.content:
Version 1.03 updates

[list]
[*] Elements such as upgraded essences and removed essences will appear on the abyss map for you to choose freely.
[*] Your character will have a random ablity tree for each new adventure.
[*] Now you can right-click to delete the established route.
[*] Adjusted the ability value of some monsters to make the difficulty curve of the game smoother.
[*] Fix some bugs.
[/list]

As the content of this update is quite different from the previous version, current game progress will be permanently erased, and each player will get 1000 gems as compensation.

notes.title: Update verion 1.01 - English Version Released
notes.content:
Version 1.01 updates
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud support
[*] English Version released 
[/list]

Now the quality of English translation is not so good, because professional translation is too expensive for me.
I need your help. If you can help me to clean up the English text, to clean up the common grammar mistakes, to make the language consistent, to decide on key-words, etc, please contact me. My email is team29x@foxmail.com.
